lines.en: label nodokachristmalloween1:
scene clearnightsky
Would it be too poetic of me to say that my heart is still in McDonald’s?
lines.zh: 我如果说「我的心还留在麦当劳」，会不会太诗意了？

lines.en: Probably. Yes. But that’s how it feels.
lines.zh: 大概会。是的。但那就是我现在的感受。

lines.en: And somewhere along the lines, I parted ways with Yasu, failed to get into contact with Ayane, and let the ghost of me clean off my table at a cheap fast-food restaurant while my body went off on its own.
lines.zh: 而在某个节点上，我和 Yasu 分道扬镳，没能联系上 Ayane，然后让我的幽灵去一家廉价快餐店收拾我的桌子，而我的身体自个儿走了。

lines.en: I’m back at the hotel now — or at least my aforementioned body is. And it rests on a cold, half-circular seat in the lobby approximately ten feet away from the door.
lines.zh: 我现在回到酒店了——至少我上面提到的那具身体回来了。它瘫在大堂里一张冰冷的半圆形座椅上，离门大约十英尺。

lines.en: Every time it opens, it feels like the weather is trying to warn me that I’d be better off outside its half-circle of influence.
lines.zh: 每一次门开，都感觉天气在试图警告我：待在它这半圆的影响范围之外会更好。

lines.en: Beneath the covers — my head in the sand of a beach I now long for disguised as a sheet. But as the ghost handles the hard labor, I get to labor over what I think is hard.
lines.zh: 在被子底下——我把头埋在一片我此刻无比渴望的沙滩里，而那片沙滩伪装成了一条床单。不过既然幽灵包揽了体力活，我就可以腾出工夫去琢磨我认为艰难的东西。

lines.en: And right now, that’s preventing myself from returning to the six-armed triumvirate of monks that guided me through the last iteration of half of this holiday.
lines.zh: 而此刻，那就是阻止自己回到那六个胳膊的三位一体僧侣身边——他们引导我度过了这个节日上一轮的一半。

lines.en: Basically, I feel dead. Overwhelmed. But without knowing why, all I can really do is sit idly by and either wait for it to blow over or wait for someone else to distract me.
lines.zh: 基本上，我觉得自己死了。不堪重负。但因为不知道为什么，我唯一能做的就是干坐着，要么等它过去，要么等别的什么人来分散我的注意力。

lines.en: And surely you know which option I chose.
lines.zh: 而你肯定知道我选了哪一个。

lines.en: scene nodokaboilertime1
I find myself curious about the weather up north — and how much colder it must be than Hell.
lines.zh: 我发现自己对北方的天气很好奇——它一定比地狱冷得多。

lines.en: The answer is ten degrees Celsius when we assume that Hell is here. Which it isn’t because Shakespeare said that Hell is empty and I guess the devils came to Kumon-mi instead.
lines.zh: 答案是十摄氏度，前提是我们假设地狱就在这儿。可惜它不是，因为莎士比亚说地狱已经空了，而那些魔鬼大概都跑到 Kumon-mi 来了。

lines.en: But as they bash my skull with their twangling instruments, pick the coral from my bones and pearls from my eyes, I have just enough time to acknowledge a thing of darkness that is mine.
lines.zh: 但当他们用叮当作响的乐器敲碎我的头骨、从我骨头里挑走珊瑚、从我眼睛里挖出珍珠时，我刚好还有时间承认——有一件黑暗之物是属于我的。

lines.en: Hark! Now, I hear them. Those endless violent knocks. “When’s the last time that I slept?” I think. Is it me these birds must mock?
lines.zh: 听！现在，我听见它们了。那无休无止的、暴力的敲门声。「我上一次睡觉是什么时候？」我想。这些鸟儿要嘲弄的是我吗？

lines.en: My light’s burnt out, I can not glow. And you left me out to rot.
lines.zh: 我的灯烧尽了，我再也无法发光。而你把我丢在外面，任我腐烂。

lines.en: So all that’s left for me to do is sit around and think about what Gossamer forgot.
lines.zh: 那么我唯一能做的，就是坐在这里，想想 Gossamer 忘了什么。

lines.en: scene nodokaboilertime2
: Hah...
Shakespeare also said that misery acquaints a man with strange bedfellows. And oh, how many unicorns have wound up in mine.
lines.zh: 莎士比亚还说过，苦难会让一个人结识奇怪的同床人。哦，有多少独角兽最终躺上了我的床。

lines.en: Awake, dear heart, awake. You lazy piece of shit. You have a job to do.
lines.zh: 醒来吧，亲爱的心，醒来吧。你这懒惰的狗屎。你有活要干。

lines.en: Just smoke your fucking cigarette and let the endorphins wash over you like the waves of the Mediterranean swelling at Prospero’s hand.
lines.zh: 就他妈的抽你的烟，让内啡肽像地中海的浪涛漫过你全身——那浪涛在 Prospero 的手中膨胀。

lines.en: : Good evening, Akira.
lines.zh: : 晚上好，Akira。

lines.en: scene nodokaboilertime3
: Your message seemed rather urgent. I came as quickly as I could.
lines.zh: : 你的消息看起来挺急的。我尽快赶来了。

lines.en: There she is — my cancer. The coming storm that will drown me in my very own book.
lines.zh: 她来了——我的癌。那场即将来临的暴风雨，会把我淹死在我自己的书里。

lines.en: : Something’s wrong and I don’t know what it is. And if I spend one more second waxing poetic, I’m pretty sure you’ll be able to make candles out of my cerebral cortex.
lines.zh: : 有什么不对劲，我不知道是什么。如果我再多花一秒钟吟诗作对，我敢肯定你能拿我的大脑皮层做出蜡烛来。

lines.en: : Oh? Then perhaps it’s best to let you stew in the freedom of thought for just a tad bit longer. A candle would be such a simple way to keep a piece of you near me at all times.
lines.zh: : 哦？那也许最好让你在思想的自由里再多炖一会儿。蜡烛是一种多么简单的方式，能让我随时留一块你在身边。

lines.en: : I need you to take my mind off of things again. You’re still willing to do that for me, right?
lines.zh: : 我需要你再帮我分散一次注意力。你还愿意为我做这件事，对吧？

lines.en: scene nodokaboilertime4
: A booty call at this hour? With so many other suitors still lining the halls like Christmalloween lights? Akira, you spoil me.
lines.zh: : 这个点的炮友召唤？外头还有那么多追求者像圣诞万圣的彩灯一样挂满走廊？Akira，你太宠我了。

lines.en: : I just...I need something. This isn’t like the other times I’ve felt off, Nodoka. It’s like something’s just gone and I can’t put my finger on what.
lines.zh: : 我只是……我需要点什么。这跟我以前那些不对劲的时候不一样，Nodoka。像是有什么东西就这么没了，而我指不出是什么。

lines.en: : And you would bestow the honor of absorbing such feelings unto me? After I was such a bad girl last time?
lines.zh: : 而你愿意把吸收这种感受的荣幸交给我？在上次我那么坏之后？

lines.en: : You mean when you fucked me into unconsciousness at the beach? Yeah, whatever. Do that again. I welcome it this time. Experiment away.
lines.zh: : 你是说你在海滩上把我操到失去意识那次？行吧，无所谓。再来一次。这次我欢迎。尽管拿我做实验。

lines.en: scene nodokaboilertime5
: Are you sure a lap pillow wouldn’t suffice? With the way you are now, I can’t help but worry that you’ll soil my dress.
lines.zh: : 你确定膝枕不够吗？看你现在的样子，我忍不住担心你会弄脏我的裙子。

lines.en: : I’ll buy you a new one. Just come with me to a love hotel and-
lines.zh: : 我给你买条新的。就跟我一起去情人酒店，然后——

lines.en: scene nodokaboilertime6
: A love hotel? Do you take me for some sort of harlot? Have you no room of your own this time?
lines.zh: : 情人酒店？你把我当成什么娼妇了吗？这次你连自己的房间都没有？

lines.en: : I don’t think so. I haven’t had much time to really mingle this year between my apocalyptic brainstorming and buying ice cream for a religious fanatic.
lines.zh: : 我想是没有。今年我在末日头脑风暴和给一个宗教狂热者买冰淇淋之间，实在没多少时间社交。

lines.en: : What an exciting day you’ve had. And here I was thinking that mine would be hard to beat.
lines.zh: : 你今天过得可真精彩。我还以为我的一天已经很难被比下去了。

lines.en: : Are we doing this or not? Because I can text someone else.
lines.zh: : 我们到底做不做？不做我就给别人发短信了。

lines.en: : If you do, can I watch? I’m quite nervous about the damage you will do to me in your current state. I’m still just a fragile little nymph, you see. And you’re a very big boy, Akira.
lines.zh: : 如果你发，我能在旁边看吗？我很担心你以现在这个状态会把我弄成什么样。你瞧，我不过是个脆弱的小妖精。而你是个非常大的男孩，Akira。

lines.en: : Okay, fine. Go back upstairs then. I’ll find someone else.
lines.zh: : 行，行。那你回楼上去吧。我找别人。

lines.en: scene nodokaboilertime7
: Okay, okay. I apologize. I see you’re in no mood for jokes tonight.
lines.zh: : 好好好。我道歉。看来你今晚确实没心情开玩笑。

lines.en: : I’m more than willing to...hear you out again. But I’d like to remind you that there is more than one way to quiet the isle once it’s full of noises, Akira.
lines.zh: : 我非常愿意再……听你倾诉。但我想提醒你，当这座海岛满是喧哗时，让它安静下来的办法不止一种，Akira。

lines.en: : Like what? You want to talk? About birds again? Let’s just cut to the part that works.
lines.zh: : 比如？你想聊天？又聊鸟？直接跳到管用的那部分吧。

lines.en: : May I at least ask you a question first?
lines.zh: : 至少让我先问你一个问题好吗？

lines.en: : Why? Is it about hugging again?
lines.zh: : 为什么？又是关于拥抱的？

lines.en: : I’m just curious as to whether or not you’re being rude to me because you don’t think of me as a girl or if your mood is really just that bad.
lines.zh: : 我只是好奇，你对我这么粗鲁，是因为你没把我当成一个女孩，还是因为你的心情真的就那么糟。

lines.en: : Because it may not seem like it at times, but I have feelings too. And quite the contrary to a certain individual, mine are rather colorful tonight.
lines.zh: : 因为虽然有时候看起来不像，但我也是有感情的。而且跟某个特定的人相反，我今晚的感情相当丰富多彩。

lines.en: : Well, I’m very happy for you. Mine aren’t.
lines.zh: : 那我真为你高兴。我的不是。

lines.en: : Yes, you’ve made that quite clear. But will you not even hear me out?
lines.zh: : 是啊，你说得很清楚了。可你连听我说完都不肯吗？

lines.en: : Because I have no intention of letting you use me if I get nothing in return, Akira. You don’t have nearly enough Nodoka points for that yet.
lines.zh: : 因为我可没打算让我什么回报都拿不到就被你使用，Akira。你的 Nodoka 点数还不够呢。

lines.en: : Can you tell me while I am using you like a fleshlight?
lines.zh: : 你能边让我把你当飞机杯用边说吗？

lines.en: : It may be difficult, but I’m willing to try.
lines.zh: : 可能有点困难，但我愿意试试。

lines.en: : Deal. Let me see if there’s a vacant room here or-
lines.zh: : 成交。让我看看这儿有没有空房，或者——

lines.en: scene nodokaboilertime8
: There’s no need.
lines.zh: : 不必了。

lines.en: : I know somewhere we won’t be disturbed...
lines.zh: : 我知道一个不会被打扰的地方……

lines.en: scene black
scene nodokaboilertime9
: The boiler room. How very Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 锅炉房。真有你的，Nodoka。

lines.en: : How beauteous the darkness is! O brave new hideaway, that has such people in it!
lines.zh: : 这黑暗何其美妙！啊，勇敢的新藏身处，里面竟有这样的人们！

lines.en: scene nodokaboilertime10
: Oh, good. Can you read minds too now? Because if I have to deal with two of you back-to-back, I’m not sure if I’ll even be able to get it up.
lines.zh: : 哦，好极了。你现在还能读心了？因为如果我得背靠背应付两个你，我不确定我还能不能硬起来。

lines.en: : Not at all. It just wasn’t hard to decipher that a man such as yourself would find comfort in the Tempest as his emotions swelled like the waves of a storm born from Prospero’s hand.
lines.zh: : 完全不会。只是不难猜到，像你这样的男人，在情绪像 Prospero 手中掀起的风暴里的浪涛一样翻涌时，会在《暴风雨》里找到安慰。

lines.en: scene nodokaboilertime11
: And also — your first love was quite the bardolater, wasn’t she? Is that where your affinity for Shakespeare comes from?
lines.zh: : 还有——你的初恋是个相当狂热的莎士比亚崇拜者，对吧？你对莎士比亚的亲近感就是从那儿来的？

lines.en: : Well?
lines.zh: : 怎么？

lines.en: scene nodokaboilertime12
: Let us not burden our remembrance with a heaviness that's gone.
lines.zh: : 我们不要再用那早已消逝的重负，去压垮我们的记忆。

lines.en: : Ah! But I long to hear the story of your life, which must captivate the ear strangely.
lines.zh: : 啊！但我渴望听听你人生的故事，那故事定能奇异地摄住耳朵。

lines.en: : You know enough already, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 你已经知道得够多了，Nodoka。

lines.en: : I do. But your tale, sir, would cure deafness. And as it stands, will I ever truly get it if all I have are the Cliffnotes?
lines.zh: : 是的。但先生，你的故事能治愈失聪。而照现在这样，如果我手里只有个精简版，我还能真正得到它吗？

lines.en: : Just fill in the blanks yourself. You’re a writer. Hell, you’ll probably make my story even more interesting that way.
lines.zh: : 你自己填空不就完了。你是个作家。搞不好你还能把我的故事讲得更有趣。

lines.en: : Ahh, but that’s where you’re mistaken. For there are times when even reality trumps fiction, Akira. That’s becoming all the more apparent to me with each passing moment.
lines.zh: : 啊，但你错了。因为有些时候，连现实都胜过虚构，Akira。随着时间一分一秒过去，这一点对我来说越来越明显。

lines.en: : Cool. Can we have sex now?
lines.zh: : 酷。我们现在能做爱了吗？

lines.en: : You taught me language, and my profit on't...
lines.zh: : 你教会了我语言，而我从中得到的收益……

lines.en: scene nodokaboilertime13
: Is, I know how to curse...
lines.zh: : 就是，我学会了怎么咒骂……

lines.en: : You know how to kill the mood as well.
lines.zh: : 你还学会了怎么败坏气氛。

lines.en: : I’m a pacifist, Akira. I do not kill anything. I am merely setting the stage for what is sure to be the dicking of a lifetime. Apologies if I want that to be special.
lines.zh: : 我是个和平主义者，Akira。我不杀任何东西。我只是在为一场注定是此生最痛快的一次挨操搭建舞台。抱歉，如果我希望那一刻是特别的。

lines.en: : Why are you so interested in me anyway? Like...yes. I’m the Boy. But now that you know, what’s the point? Why dig deeper? She’s dead. There’s nothing more to learn.
lines.zh: : 你到底为什么对我这么感兴趣？好比说……对。我就是那个「男孩」。可既然你现在知道了，意义在哪？为什么还要往深挖？她已经死了。没什么可学的了。

lines.en: : But did you see her die?
lines.zh: : 可你亲眼看到她死了吗？

lines.en: scene nodokaboilertime14
: I did actually. Want me to recount it right now? Will hearing about her skull fragments decorating the concrete get you wet?
lines.zh: : 事实上我看到了。要我现在复述一遍吗？听我说她的头骨碎片怎么点缀了水泥地，能让你湿吗？

lines.en: : It might if you describe it like that. Is it getting hot in here, or is it maybe just all of the boilers?
lines.zh: : 你要是这么描述的话，可能会。是这里变热了，还是大概只是因为这些锅炉？

lines.en: : Sorry, are you trying to piss me off? Is this how you...what, get me to black out again? Is that the goal here?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你是想惹毛我吗？这就是你……什么，让我再昏过去一次的办法？这就是目的？

lines.en: scene nodokaboilertime15

: I have no desire to hurt you, Akira. You’re the closest thing to both a father and a lover that I’ve ever had. And surely you know how precious such a combination must be to a pervert like me, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 我不想伤害你，Akira。你是我这辈子拥有过的、最接近父亲与情人的人。你肯定知道，这样一种组合对一个像我这样的变态来说有多珍贵，不是吗？

lines.en: : Yes. So why won’t you just take the pain away already? I don’t want to talk right now. I want this to be over.
lines.zh: : 对。那你为什么还不赶紧把痛带走？我现在不想说话。我想让这一切结束。

lines.en: : Ahh — and there’s the rub.
lines.zh: : 啊——问题就在这里。

lines.en: scene nodokaboilertime16
: For there can be no end to this vicious cycle. And I mean that in more ways than one, if you catch my drift.
lines.zh: : 因为这个恶性循环不会有尽头。而且我说这句话，可不止一个意思——你懂我的言下之意吧。

lines.en: : I don’t care about your fucking-
lines.zh: : 我才不在乎你他妈的——

lines.en: : Think, Akira. Calm your mind and think of what I just said.
lines.zh: : 思考，Akira。冷静下来，想想我刚刚说了什么。

lines.en: : I...I don’t...
scene nodokaboilertime17
: You do, though. You just don’t want to believe it.
lines.zh: : 不，你知道的。你只是不愿意相信。

lines.en: : Nodoka-
lines.zh: : Nodoka——

lines.en: scene nodokaboilertime18
: I had a dream last night — that a great disaster consumed this world. And as it went, so did we. But to where was not exactly clear.
lines.zh: : 我昨晚做了个梦——一场巨大的灾难吞噬了这个世界。它去了，我们也去了。但去了哪里，并不清楚。

lines.en: : For it was a place that looked just like this one. Just as depraved and sad and lost among the stars, entirely unremarkable once removed from the lens of a microscope.
lines.zh: : 因为那个地方看起来跟这里一模一样。一样堕落、一样悲伤、一样迷失在群星之间，一旦从显微镜的镜头里挪开，就完全平平无奇。

lines.en: : In that dream, everything stopped but me. And I roamed the lands in search of answers to all of the questions I struggle to ask when that thing we call “life” flourishes around us.
lines.zh: : 在那个梦里，一切都停了下来，只有我没有。我漫步在这片土地上，寻找所有那些问题的答案——那些当我们称之为「生活」的东西在周围繁盛时，我难以开口去问的问题。

lines.en: : It was quite boring for a dream, really. There was no monster threateningly following behind me, silently waiting for the right time to pounce.
lines.zh: : 作为一个梦，那实在挺无聊的。没有怪物在我身后威胁地跟着，静静等待扑上来的时机。

lines.en: : But there was a girl. One who seems more like a silhouette in hindsight — who smelled of coriander and tobacco — looming in the background, existing somewhere she shouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 但有一个女孩。回想起来更像一道剪影——身上有芫荽和烟草的味道——在背景里若隐若现，存在于某个她不该存在的地方。

lines.en: : Have you ever had a dream like that, Akira?
lines.zh: : 你做过那样的梦吗，Akira？

lines.en: scene yasumcdonalds34
scene yasumcdonalds35
scene yasumcdonalds36
scene nodokaboilertime19
: A dream where something that shouldn’t exist does? Whether it be from another world...or another time perhaps?
lines.zh: : 一个梦里有什么不该存在的东西存在？无论是来自另一个世界……还是也许来自另一个时间？

lines.en: : It’s happening again...
lines.zh: : 又来了……

lines.en: : What is?
lines.zh: : 什么又来了？

lines.en: : That...feeling. That there’s something that’s supposed to be there and it’s just not anymore.
lines.zh: : 那种……感觉。那种本该在那儿的东西，现在就是不在了的感觉。

lines.en: : Ayane must have felt it too. That’s why she-
lines.zh: : Ayane 一定也感觉到了。所以她才——

lines.en: scene nodokaboilertime20
: Ngh!?
lines.zh: : 嗯呃！？

lines.en: : This is how they want you to feel, Akira! The doors I chase after are not the kind that we are meant to open!
lines.zh: : 他们就是想让你有这种感觉，Akira！我追逐的那些门，不是我们该打开的那种！

lines.en: : People like us are destined to queue outside and wait for the chance to get in! It’s no wonder that everything I’ve done has amounted to nothing so far!
lines.zh: : 像我们这样的人，注定要在外面排队，等待进去的机会！怪不得我至今所做的一切都毫无成果！

lines.en: : The trick was to stop looking! Let the answers come to us instead!
lines.zh: : 诀窍就是别再找了！让答案自己来找我们！

lines.en: scene nodokaboilertime21
: And come they did — for in this moment, where everything seems so blurry to you, my sight has never been so clear.
lines.zh: : 而它们确实来了——因为在这一刻，当一切对你来说都那么模糊的时候，我的视线从未如此清晰。

lines.en: : (DIALOGUE FORCIBLY CENSORED. THIS CHARACTER HAS BEEN CORRUPTED.)
lines.zh: : （对话被强制屏蔽。此角色已损坏。）

lines.en: : If it’s god that you fear, why not become one yourself?
lines.zh: : 如果你惧怕的是神，那为什么不自己成为神？

lines.en: scene nodokaboilertime22
: Or, if that won’t work, hide.
lines.zh: : 或者，如果那行不通，就躲起来。

lines.en: : For they can find us here in Kumon-mi, or even in our heads.
lines.zh: : 因为他们能在 Kumon-mi 找到我们，甚至能在我们的脑子里找到我们。

lines.en: : But there is somewhere out there beyond the reach of god that I know we can get to if we can find the right door and someone to open it.
lines.zh: : 但有一个地方在神的触及范围之外，我知道只要我们找到那扇对的门、找到能打开它的人，我们就能到那儿。

lines.en: : Maybe that’s where you’ll find what you’re looking for.
lines.zh: : 也许在那儿，你会找到你在找的东西。

lines.en: scene nodokaboilertime23
: But in the meantime, you have me.
lines.zh: : 但在此期间，你有我。

lines.en: : And despite how mad I may make you...or how desperately you flail as you attempt to decipher the often meaningless things I have to say...
lines.zh: : 尽管我可能让你发疯……尽管你在试图解读我那些往往毫无意义的话时拼命挣扎……

lines.en: : Despite all that, you will never be alone. For there will always be someone twice as capable, searching three times as hard for something four times bigger.
lines.zh: : 尽管如此，你永远不会孤单。因为总会有一个能力是你两倍的人，以三倍的努力去搜寻四倍大的东西。

lines.en: : And I like you enough to share what I find.
lines.zh: : 而我够喜欢你，愿意把我找到的分享给你。

lines.en: : Yet I can’t help but wonder if you’d do the same for me?
lines.zh: : 可我还是忍不住想，你会不会为我做同样的事？

lines.en: : Nodoka...just for clarity’s sake...
lines.zh: : Nodoka……为了说清楚……

lines.en: : Do you know that we’re caught in a timeloop?...
lines.zh: : 你知道我们被困在时间循环里了吗？……

lines.en: : I had a feeling.
lines.zh: : 我有过预感。

lines.en: : I just wanted to hear it from a different horse’s mouth this time.
lines.zh: : 我只是这次想从另一张嘴里听到。

lines.en: scene nodokaboilertime24
: Now — I believe this is the part where you take me.
lines.zh: : 现在——我想，接下来就是你占有我的部分了。
